title: Some people don't consider Trading a "Real Job."
summary: I had a friend tell me today "well I prefer a real job." Because I said I was doing just fine trading, haven't had much luck finding a job after getting downsized. I just think it is rude. Everyone always think Traders are like Gamblers. I agree with a lot of people , that don't even tell people you trade. They always judge you.submitted by/u/wierick[link][comments]
